reviews.text: And the prayers don’t even look the same as adding extra Wajids & mustahabs in there that I usually don’t say and you can’t even take them off so it’s just confusing my whole prayer & throwing it off so now I’m gonna have to delete this app and find a new one

reviews.title: Incorrect prayer times
reviews.text: I have multiple different apps to tell me what time to pray.. this app is off by almost 20 minutes. I’m glad I checked the other apps. I would’ve been praying beyond earlier than what I had to.
